string-array.name: import_bitwarden_steps
string-array.item: In the Bitwarden app or web vault, open Settings, then Vault, then Export vault.
Choose the .json format, or .json (Password protected) to protect the file with a password of your choosing, and confirm the export.
Choose the exported file here. Logins that have an authenticator key are brought across.

resources.string: An export protected with your account\'s encryption key can\'t be opened here; choose a file password instead. The Bitwarden Authenticator app\'s own export (Settings, then Export) reads here too.
